The Tenno Sho (Spring)—Giving it her 
absolute all, Mejiro Ryan claims victory, 
thwarting Mejiro McQueen's long-cherished 
ambition.

Though frustrated by the loss, Mejiro 
McQueen praised Mejiro Ryan's victory.

And... finding herself in the position of 
being chased, Mejiro Ryan declared she 
would rise to her challenge.

Mejiro Ryan's next goal is the Takarazuka 
Kinen, which crowns the spring 
middle-distance champion. With this 
performance, ranking near the top of the 
fan poll is no mere dream!
